Port.help: The UDP port to receive OSC on. It must match the port the sender transmits to.

Addscope.label: OSC Address Scope
Addscope.help: Which OSC addresses to accept, as a pattern. '*' takes everything. Narrow it when several tools share one port.

Localaddress.label: Local Address
Localaddress.help: Which network interface to listen on. Empty means all of them; set it on a machine with several network cards.

Active2.label: Talkback Active
Active2.help: Send values back out over OSC as they change, so a controller with motorised faders or LEDs can follow TouchDesigner.

Address.label: Network Address
Address.help: The host talkback is sent to. 127.0.0.1 stays on this machine; use the controller's IP to reach it over the network.

Localaddress2.label: Local Address
Localaddress2.help: Which network interface talkback is sent from. '*' lets the OS choose.

Port2.label: Port
Port2.help: The UDP port talkback is sent to. It must match the port the receiving device listens on, and is normally not the port above.

Mappingtablerepositorie.label: Mappingtable
Mappingtablerepositorie.help: The table DAT holding the mappings. Point it at another table to keep mappings somewhere else, in a shared component for instance.

Cfautoregister.label: Auto-register
Cfautoregister.help: When on, keep this tool published into the global config registry while this component exists.

Cfautoload.label: Auto-load
Cfautoload.help: Apply this tool's saved section from the config file once per session, shortly after the tool registers. Turn off for a tool whose settings should stay project-local.

Cfpersistpars.label: Persist Parameters
Cfpersistpars.help: Snapshot and restore the tool COMP's custom parameters (value, expression, bind + mode). Meta pages (About, Version Ctrl, Info, Callbacks, Common) are always skipped; missing parameters are never created on load.

Cfexcludepars.label: Exclude Pars
Cfexcludepars.help: Space-separated name patterns (tdu.match) of custom parameters to leave out of persistence, e.g. 'Spoutactive Ndi*'. Use for parameters that must boot at their defaults.

Cfexcludepages.label: Exclude Pages
Cfexcludepages.help: Space-separated page-name patterns to leave out of persistence entirely.

Hbautoregister.label: Show in Hub
Hbautoregister.help: Publish this tab into FNS_Hub while the component exists. Off = the tool shows nothing in the hub and its panel stays wherever it lives.

Hbdisplayed.label: Shown in Hub
Hbdisplayed.help: Show this tab on the hub's tab bar. Off keeps the tab registered but hidden. The hub's tab manager can show it again.

Hbtablabel.label: Tab Label
Hbtablabel.help: What the hub's tab bar shows. Empty = the canonical name.

Hbtaborder.label: Tab Order
Hbtaborder.help: Position in the hub's tab bar; the surface configurators sit at 10/20/30, the console viewer at 90; contributions default to 50 and sort by label within an order.
